# Citeworthy

> Citeworthy is a full-service Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) agency. We audit, implement, and monitor AI-search visibility so brands get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.

Citeworthy runs a three-phase engagement for every client: a citability audit, hands-on implementation (content rewrites, schema, llms.txt, crawler access fixes), and ongoing AI visibility monitoring. This is not a one-time report — we ship the fixes and track citation rate over time.

## Services

- [Citability audit](https://citeworthy.ai/services#audit): a full diagnostic of AI crawler access, structured data, and content extractability, benchmarked against named competitors.
- [Implementation](https://citeworthy.ai/services#implementation): content rewrites, JSON-LD schema, llms.txt authoring, and AI crawler access fixes, shipped directly by our team.
- [AI visibility monitoring](https://citeworthy.ai/services#monitoring): monthly tracking of citation rate, brand mentions, and share of voice across major AI answer engines.
